# EngineerOS

EngineerOS is an AI-native workspace for engineers, researchers, and builders. It combines notes, tasks, projects, and daily entries into one connected system with semantic search, a knowledge graph, and an AI assistant with citations.

## What EngineerOS does

- Capture notes, tasks, and daily entries in one place
- Search everything with semantic (AI-powered) search
- Visualize connections between your notes and tasks as a knowledge graph
- Get AI-powered answers with citations back to source notes
- Automate recurring tasks and daily note creation

## Key pages

- / — Landing page with product overview
- /register — Create a free account
- /login — Sign in to your workspace
- /dashboard — Your home workspace view
- /notes — Browse and search all notes
- /tasks — Manage tasks and kanban boards
- /projects — Organize work into projects
- /daily — Daily notes with goals, journal, wins, and problems
- /bookmarks — Save and organize links
- /reading — Track reading progress
- /meetings — Meeting notes with dates and attendees
- /settings — Workspace and account settings

## Pricing

EngineerOS is free to start. Data lives in your own Supabase project — no vendor lock-in. See /pricing for structured pricing data.

## AI features

- Semantic search across all workspace content
- AI assistant with source citations
- Automatic knowledge graph from wikilinks and task links
- Automation rules for recurring tasks, quick captures, and daily rollover
